- *(ats)* Apply the candidate's CRDs with --force-conflicts — helm owns .spec.versions of the CRDs it installed, so the upgrade hook failed on the first bump that changed a CRD (muster 5.8.0) in [#153](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform-standalone/pull/153) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
